question: In a drama, Hema spoke “Swaraj is my birth right and I shall have it”. Which Indian freedom fighter gave this slogan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak** gave the slogan** "Swaraj is my birth right and I shall have it".**
 
• Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak was a prominen**t Indian nationalist leader**, **social reformer, and freedom fighter** who played a significant role in India's struggle for independence against British rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi, **also known as the** Father of the Nation**, was another Indian freedom fighter who played a crucial role in India's struggle for independence.

 
 
• He is known for his philosophy of **non-violent resistance. **
 
 
 
• **Ambika Charan Majumdar **was an Indian revolutionary who participated in the **Chittagong armoury raid in 1930.**
 
 
• He was executed by the British authorities in **1931.**
 
 
 
• **Bhagat Singh **was an **Indian socialist revolutionary** who played a significant role in India's struggle for independence.
 
 
• He is known for his involvement in the** Lahore conspiracy case **and his martyrdom at the **young age of 23.**
